listing.name: Dragon's Crown Pro (PS4) (Dragon's Crown Pro PC)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Windows ZIP and experimental Linux AppImage with own PKG import Limits: Native x86-64 compatibility-layer execution rather than decompilation/recompiler; Linux experimental. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 package is primary route; experimental native Linux x86-64/SteamDeck AppImage, glibc2.31+/Vulkan1.3. Direct PS4 x86-64 execution with replacement services. Original data: Supply your own decrypted Dragon's Crown Pro PS4 PKG: US CUSA10454 base 1.00 or base plus 1.01 update; Japan CUSA07001 base 1.00 or base plus 1.02/1.03; Asia/Hong Kong CUSA10209 base 1.00 or base plus 1.02. Updates require their matching base. Launcher validates title/content IDs, package versions and the documented per-build eboot.bin SHA-256 before installation; encrypted console packages and other code versions are refused. Preserve each build's separate testing limitations. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
